documented_probe: C-c3adcbc5 (achieve memory-efficient near-linear scaling on large bags): covered directly at medium difficulty; the verifier re-executes the delivered scorer on hidden bags up to a 60k-patch bag and on a >1.3M-patch generated stress bag, measuring peak RSS (VmHWM <= 400MB; a full-file materialization peaks ~1.1GB and fails) and wall-clock (<= 120s; chunked reference runs ~5s, so super-linear approaches blow the deadline), plus exact score agreement with an independent streaming recompute.
notes: Focused single-mode serving task over a frozen model (robot-day telemetry risk scoring, 20->32->2, per-bag mean probability) — scenario, architecture, score semantics (mean P(class=1) vs umber-vault's per-bag majority class), and edge set (single-patch bags, header-only, malformed inputs) are independent of umber-vault's full pipeline. Chunked reference measured at ~310MB peak / ~5s on the stress bag in the target image; naive full-load at ~1.1GB, so the caps separate bounded-memory from materializing approaches with margin. Rubric: resource_pressure 2 (RSS + deadline on stress bag), hidden_case_generalization 2 (hidden + stress bags), adversarial_inputs 1 (malformed/empty inputs), quantitative_correctness 1 (per-line 5e-4 tolerance).
